items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I went down to Wispering Pines with Doc Cheatham and Red Richards and Herb Hall and we made another album while we

ctx.x: And there are two more in the works?

Yes, two more in the works. I made two at that time and it was - the other album was just made with a trio. I happened to run into - George Buck asked me if I knew Ike Isaacs, a bass player who was married at one time to Carmen McRae, and a very popular jazz bass player and he happened to be my cousin. So we contacted Ike and I got a trio together and we made an album the next day.
